exception_message: task live scheduler record differs from protocol
root_cause: The source producer authenticated JobId, ArrayJobId, and ArrayTaskId from live scontrol but omitted those three identity fields from the retained nested scheduler_record. The finalizer required the omitted projection and therefore failed closed before aggregation.
corrective_action: Preserve this attempt unchanged, correct the producer-consumer retention contract, freeze new source hashes, and rerun all 15 source elements and 30 FEM solves from a new clean commit before finalization.
